cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Say You Saw It Too
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit noticing the impossible detail before you reveal how much you believe it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll lock up in a minute. Did you notice a shadow leave?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll tell you. First, was the chair still inside when its shadow reached the door?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then stay with me. I held the door for it, and I'm waiting for it to come back.

reason: Ground the immediate closing task and give a reciprocal-account promise; reveal door-holding belief only after B independently confirms the chair stayed, without the now-I-can-admit explanation.
